findings.action: Make test-compatibility-only mechanically constrained to verified test/fixture contexts or replace it with narrowly identified, executable exemptions; add a negative control showing that a production producer cannot self-select this disposition.
evidence: validate_inventory computes raw_directories only when disposition != test-compatibility-only.
No predicate ties test-compatibility-only to a test path, fixture context, optional-module fallback, or otherwise mechanically verified reachability.

Consequently, adding a detected production tempfile.mkdtemp or TemporaryDirectory call together with a test-compatibility-only manifest row can satisfy missing/stale checks while avoiding the unowned-directory failure.
findings.summary: The recurrence gate has a manifest-controlled exemption that can admit a new production directory producer.

findings.action: Bind the migrated producer implementations and evidence showing each target's transport and verdict behavior; include integrated observations for the acceptance matrix and registry/final-consumer readback.
evidence: The RCA names seven affected producer sites, but six relevant shell implementations are absent from the semantic input.

Manifest declarations and rationales do not prove those producers consume CHARNESS_OWNED_SCRATCH_ROOT, preserve existing exit behavior, or avoid anonymous roots on success, failure, timeout, and cancellation.
The supplied process matrix exercises a synthetic shell fixture through run_owned_scratch_command.py, not each migrated shell/JS target or a representative integrated quality-runner path.
findings.summary: Migration and per-target acceptance are not evidenced for all historical producers.

findings.action: Include and verify the canonical gate registration, with an execution receipt demonstrating missing, stale, and unregistered mutations fail the actual standing/pre-merge path.
evidence: A checker implementation and its unit tests are present, but no gate list, workflow, hook, or standing-quality registration that invokes it is reviewed.
The packet's owning-surface validators do not list check_temp_producer_inventory.py as an acceptance command.
A discoverer that is not proven to run cannot replace the voluntary-adoption mental model identified as the root cause.
findings.summary: The packet does not establish that producer discovery is enforced before merge.

findings.action: Document and bind a complete candidate-search inventory for supported languages/APIs, add axis-varying escape tests for import scope and command syntax, and disposition any intentionally unsupported producer families.
evidence: Python discovery recognizes only tempfile imports found at module top level and a fixed API set.
Shell discovery is regex- and line-shape-dependent; directory recognition only matches whitespace-delimited -d or --directory.
JavaScript discovery narrowly recognizes mkdtempSync(...tmpdir()) and an assignment pattern containing CHARNESS_OWNED_SCRATCH_ROOT.
The tests cover selected quoting, comments, aliases, and stable identities, but no evidence establishes completeness across all production temporary-output APIs and syntactic variants.
findings.summary: The claimed exhaustive sibling search exceeds the detector's demonstrated coverage.

lens: Assess the resolution and recurrence protection for each target, with an evidence-backed behavioral verdict. Pass only when the repair is supported; block or defer when it is not. Diagnosis alone is insufficient. Additional caller focus: Verify the bug root cause is actually removed, every acceptance boundary has concrete evidence, producer discovery prevents recurrence, and no sibling temporary-output path remains unaccounted for. Distinguish blockers from non-claims.
next_move: Keep issue #813 open. Remove the production-exemption bypass, bind the inventory checker into an executed standing gate, and provide behavioral evidence for every historical producer plus an exhaustive, dispositioned sibling search.
non_claims: This review does not claim the runtime-scratch primitive itself is defective.
This review does not require Charness to sweep arbitrary system temporary directories.
This review does not require proof of external-tool cleanup after every possible host or kernel failure.
No judgment is made about files outside the identity-bound semantic payload.

evidence: The seven historical shell/JS producer implementations are not all included: only scripts/agent-runtime/run-local-eval-test.mjs is present; the cited check-shell, check-python-lint, check-links-internal, check-links-external, check-markdown, and check-secrets implementations are absent.

scripts/gates/check_temp_producer_inventory.py exempts every detected directory producer whose manifest disposition is test-compatibility-only, without validating that the producer is actually confined to tests or compatibility fixtures.
The packet includes the inventory checker but no quality configuration or execution receipt proving that this checker is invoked by the required pre-merge/standing gate.

tests/test_temp_producer_inventory.py supplies missing, unregistered, and stale controls and a standalone adapter terminal matrix, but the packet supplies no test-run results and no per-historical-producer behavioral observations.
The spec declares implementation complete while the debug artifact still says Implementation verification remains pending and Resolution: open.
target_observations.summary: The packet demonstrates a plausible owned-scratch adapter and focused controls, but it does not prove that every historical producer was migrated or that the inventory is an enforced, non-bypassable recurrence boundary. The repair therefore remains approval-ineligible.
